verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents vendor-run recurring services: auto-filing of annual reports, Compliance Calendar deadline reminders, and auto-renewing subscriptions. None of these lets the user define or schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows. These are fixed managed services and notifications, an adjacent feature rather than user-configurable scheduling, so no credit is earned for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
